newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks close lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks close lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Madrid stocks were beset by profit-taking on Friday, with both indices ending lower and Telefonica shares underperforming, dealers said.
The general index fell 2.98 points, 0.59 percent, to 499.21 and the Ibex-35 shed 40.10 points, 0.69 percent, to 5,732.59.
All key stocks were down with Telefonica off 55 pesetas to 3,655 and Repsol slipping 70 pesetas to 6,080.
"The market was tired after the recent rise, but there's still buying interest, especially in selected banking shares," a dealer in Madrid said.

Gas Natural, in which Repsol has a 45 percent stake, ended down 3.6 percent to 30,350 pesetas. Repsol, in its last day of a share offer, informed stock market commission CNMV that first quarter operating results for both it and Gas Natural will be negatively affected by a mild winter.
This prompted sales today, dealers said. However they added that the stock needed a rest after huge gains in the run-up to the privatisation.
The final price for the Repsol offer will be set after Wall Street's close on Monday.
